items.name: Palmerston North 2022
items.information: Palmerston North 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Going Fast in Idaho 2022
items.information:
Please be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1veNWzPcM9sTuWmuBfvyzVbQxbvoNDuIZ-0w6SAyFbz4/edit?usp=sharing) for this competition.

Masks are required while competiting, judging, scrambling, etc. Masks are highly recommended for everyone while in the venue. Competitors may only bring one spectator with them.

Most competitors will be expected to be a judge or runner. Please look through the [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoingFastinIdaho2022#17331-competing) and [Judging and Running](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoingFastinIdaho2022#17332-judging-and-running) tabs before registering.
 
 Competitors are encouraged to bring their own pens.
